messages:
carmen li: Hi team — Carmen here, first day on Platform. Quick: MDM invite didn't show and my laptop battery is low. Who should I ping for device enrollment/charger? Also bringing a tiny fern and debating miso vs tom yum for lunch.
izzy (onboarding buddy): welcome Carmen!! i'll resend the MDM invite now. chargers live on the ops shelf marked 'new-hires'. miso vote from me.
marcos v: hey Carmen — welcome! VPN creds come after MDM. if you need doc access before that DM me and i'll open a temp rule.
jamie (people ops): welcome!! small welcome at 12:30 in the kitchen. check the onboarding portal for any leftover forms. fern ok but try not to spill soil on the table 😅
ops-bot: [automated] MDM invite resent to carmen.li@redwood.com at 2026-03-10 17:02:05 UTC.
izzy (onboarding buddy): quick enroll steps: 1) click "Enroll device" in the MDM email 2) install agent 3) approve in 1Password Onboarding vault 4) reboot and connect to redwood-vpn (WireGuard). paste any errors here.
carmen li: found it in spam (classic). installing now. miso it is — i'll bring a thermos :)
marcos v: after vpn, run `ssh git@redwood-repo` to check repo access. passphrase prompt is expected.
izzy (onboarding buddy): adding you to #platform and calendar invites. see you at lunch!
carmen li: enrolled, rebooted, vpn connected. uploaded a tiny fern pic: https://imgur.com/example-f3rn
marcos v: lovely. welcome aboard — ping me if git perms need tweaking.
jamie (people ops): tiny checklist complete: MDM ✅ VPN ✅ Slack ✅ lunch 12:30 ✅
carmen li: thanks everyone — see you at lunch!
